category.description: Stable policy category key. Current pages support the core categories; future gold-standard data may add policy-only categories before public pages use them.

amount.description: Published amount when fixed. Use a short string only when the airline publishes a range, a booking-path price, included allowance, or a non-price rule.

currency.description: ISO-like currency code for priced rows. Use the airline's published currency; keep existing site currency codes stable.

conditions.description: Short factual label explaining the rule. No advice, speculation, or marketing copy.

applies_to.description: Fare, cabin, passenger type, bag number, or product to which the row applies.

region_or_route.description: Route scope such as US domestic, transatlantic, within Europe, Air France-operated flights, or all routes.

timing.description: Purchase or application timing: at booking, manage booking, online check-in, airport, gate, before departure, after 24h, per direction, each way.

source_url.description: Primary airline-published source URL whenever possible.

last_verified.description: Date the row was checked against the source, in YYYY-MM-DD.

effective_date.description: Date the fee or policy took effect when the airline publishes it.

source_name.description: Human-readable source label, such as United checked-bag policy.

confidence.description: Use confirmed for direct source support; ambiguous when the source confirms variability but not the exact amount; not_published when the airline does not publish a value.

calc.description: Optional structured calculator hints. These should never override the published source row.

notes.description: Optional short factual note. Do not put page-level advice here.
